title: Redis out-of-memory eviction causing cache stampede
symptoms: Redis memory usage at 100%. Logs showing: redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: OOM command not allowed when used memory > maxmemory. Cache hit rate dropped from 85% to 3%. Database CPU spiked to 100% due to cache stampede.
root_cause: Redis maxmemory was set to 512MB but session data from a marketing campaign grew to 700MB. With allkeys-lru eviction, critical application keys were being evicted. When multiple services tried to repopulate the cache simultaneously, it caused a stampede on the database.
fix_applied: 1. Increased Redis maxmemory to 2GB. 2. Changed eviction policy to volatile-lru to protect non-expiring keys. 3. Implemented cache stampede protection with probabilistic early expiration. 4. Added Redis memory alerts at 70% threshold.
